criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First sentence names UAF, the model, 13 years and 700,000-plus records, and the closure consequence, all within the 210-char see-more cutoff. Second and third sentences surface the ownership-vs-tenancy tension. No banned openers.

criteria.name: Industry relevance
criteria.notes: All four covered stories name an Alaska angle and a sector consequence with dollar anchors. The fifth verified finding (SBA 8(a)/ANC contracting) was editorially omitted, holding the score at 9.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Named individuals, data points, volume descriptor, legislative specifics, agency and base names, and federal program detail appear in nearly every sentence.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: UAF release plus three regional outlets; ADN and APM for LNG; News-Miner and KTUU for GVEA; NSF primary solicitation for TechAccess. Every claim maps to two credible sources or a primary source.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Matches post_001.md: position-taking, structural framing, plain English, essayistic register, no first-person we/us, no hype or influencer cadence.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: Tight paragraphs, single 3-item bullet block within rules, 444 words and 2685 chars both within window. Scans on mobile and desktop.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: A real binary choice tied to the ownership-vs-tenancy tension, naming a specific entity and verb. No CTA or rhetorical softener.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: Four separate this-week decision triggers (UAF tool for 2026 planning, June 19 LNG Senate vote, June 29 GVEA bids, June 16 NSF LOI) for the program-manager audience.

one_sentence_fix: Fold in a one-sentence note on the SBA 8(a) proposed rule (comments due July 13, ANC carve-out confirmed) to use the fifth verified finding and push industry relevance to a full 10.
